Study every AVAILABLE view equally, including small stroke junctions, bar lengths, counters and separate legs. An UNAVAILABLE blank is not evidence. Shape only their centerline paths; no swelling, brush contrast, taper, pointed ends, roughness, texture, serifs, shadows or decoration. Roundcaps and smoothly rounded joins; controlled curves, generous open channels and counters. Preserve exact stroke inventory, meaningful short/long bar relationships, detachments and attachments.

3. Below top motif a separate rounded eye enclosure with exactly THREE stacked counters (two full horizontal dividers).

5. Under that eye support baseline are TWO short downward/outward hooked branches, left and right. Preserve both small branches.
6. Bottom right has a curved central down-right tail crossed by a broad turned return course with two left-facing horizontal/slanted ends and a rounded right return, enclosing exactly ONE right-hand lower counter. Keep single long down-right tail and both left-facing stroke ends.
